protocol.scope: Descriptive ablation on all929 reused BenchLS development cases. No test labels or new correctness labels.
protocol.hypothesis: A fixed hard sense-fit floor can reject listed substitutes already supported by the learned contextual ranker.
protocol.variant: Remove only the0.10 sense-fit floor, retaining cached candidate guards, candidate pool, frozen52features and unchanged learned OOF probabilities.
protocol.groups: Frozen10fold target-word groups, identical to contextual baseline
protocol.retention_bar: For an opt-in policy, mean net gain >=5 at0.45, and precision >=0.90 and coverage >=0.20 at0.80 in every repeat. Also require native behavior verification and audit regression comparison. No default or demo change.
protocol.no_search: These are the two existing contextual policy thresholds. No floor grid, threshold tuning, additional model fitting, TSAR labels or reserved-domain outputs. Known failures used to motivate this analysis are development diagnostics, not independent confirmation.
